messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: PRIVNET_EGRESS_5 triggered for customer AuroraEdge (private VPC). Symptom: ~50% 5xx from NLB -> tenant targets in us-west-2. Runbook: /runbooks/privnet-egress. Paging policy: primary oncall.
sre-oncall: I'm on it. Gathering quick context — checking NLB target health + recent SG changes.
netops: I see spike in backend 5xx starting 2024-11-05T22:12Z correlated with asymmetric pathing from nat gateway pool. Could be SNAT exhaustion on tenant's private subnet, some flows hitting wrong AZ targets.
eng-infra: Reproduced partial connectivity: some targets report TCP resets from backend trace. NLB healthchecks still passing on some zones, failing on others. Possible security group state drift after recent tenant policy push.
alice: @sre-oncall can you confirm if this impacts dedicated pool fallback? AuroraEdge is on Dedicated+Privnet mix per contract.
sre-oncall: Confirmed — host routing table shows sticky sessions from same source hitting different SNAT IPs. For AuroraEdge's tenant id 5421, we see 30-60% requests dropped. Impacting production inference for a small subset of customers behind that tenant.
customer-success: Drafting a quick customer-facing update. Suggest: "We're investigating intermittent errors for requests routed through your private VPC. Our on-call team is actively triaging and we will provide a remediation ETA within 30 minutes." Want approval to send?
bob: please hold on outbound customer message until we have mitigation path. Ops is trying an ephemeral route injection to pin SNAT for tenant 5421 and roll traffic to Dedicated pool as a failover if pinning fails.
netops: Executing ephemeral routing change now:```
# run on control-plane
rtrctl inject-route --tenant 5421 --src-prefix 10.12.0.0/20 --nexthop 10.200.5.2 --sticky-ttl 600
```
eng-infra: Applying NLB target rebalancing to prefer healthy AZs and temporarily disable cross-zone load balancing for AuroraEdge targets. Command: `lbctl update --nlb auroraedge-nlb --cross-zone off --target-group tg-5421 --drain-grace 30s`
sre-oncall: Monitoring metrics: 2m after route inject we see 15% drop in 5xx, after target rebalance down to 7%. Still intermittent. Next step: plan B = failover to dedicated pool 3 (dpool-usw2-3). I will coordinate.
alice: If we failover, we need to rotate secrets for the private agent connector and reissue short-lived certs. Eng-infra can prepare the rollout plan.
eng-infra: Preparing canary failover now. Steps: 1) advertise route -> dpool-usw2-3 2) update SGs on dpool to allow tenant 5421 prefix 3) issue cert and attach agent. Running step 2: `sgctl modify --sg sg-dpool-usw2 --allow 10.12.0.0/20:443`
sre-oncall: Canary traffic 5% diverted to dpool, running health checks. Initial probe OK (200/200), latency stable.
customer-success: Ok preparing message: "Update: We identified inconsistent egress routing from your private VPC causing intermittent request failures. We've applied a temporary routing pin and are running a controlled failover to a dedicated pool to restore full service. No data was exposed. We'll confirm when all traffic is restored." Sending now.
bob: :thumbsup: Good. Keep me posted before we convert all traffic.
eng-infra: Canary successful for 10 minutes. Scaling to 50% for 5m window. If no regression, we'll cut 100% and then revoke temporary routing injection.
sre-oncall: Cutting over to 100% to dpool-usw2-3 now. Monitoring logs + tracing.
netops: After cutover, NLB 5xx drops under 0.5% and client error rate back to baseline. Rolling back target rebalance changes (re-enable cross-zone) and removing ephemeral route:```
rtrctl remove-route --tenant 5421 --id ephemeral-1758504322
```
eng-infra: Completed cleanup: sg changes left as-is (dpool needs them during verification) but we'll revert in 30m. Documenting runbook deviations in incident ticket.
sre-oncall: Passing to next oncall for post-incident monitoring & RCA pickup. Handoff to @alice for long-term remediation.
alice: Taking it. I'll coordinate with AuroraEdge on SNAT capacity increases and tenancy guardrails. Creating follow-up RFC and scheduling postmortem call.
incident-bot: Incident PRIVNET_EGRESS_5 resolved for tenant 5421. Severity: sev2 -> mitigated. Timeline and notes added to https://incidents.redwood/1758504322. :white_check_mark:
